title: ID0445275-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/R7 170002201] Screensaver not visible
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The Screensaver are not visible in the Display. The checked the SCB Screensaver setup and updated it several times but the display
just shows a blue screen.
Solution: Change screensaver's photo name - incompatibility with the special characters - test always with "photo.png"

additional_info.subject: ID0445275-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/R7 170002201] Display shows blue screen CRM:02889000473
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex, good afternoon.
Sorry for the delay, we have a surge of tickets.
I checked this charger remotely and the screen is showing the correct outlets now and currently charging.
I believe the configuration of the Outlets group was not included which is known bug, be aware that sometimes you need to "Load data from charger" twice in order to see these groups, at the first attempt sometimes it doesn't show:
If you still don't see the outlets even after these groups are added, always do a simple change in the outlet ID in the box below.
E.g:
Change Id3 to 4, Id4 to 1, Id1 to 2, Id2 to 3 -> save -> redo the changes to normal way.
This should work.
I recommend as always updating to the latest FW version as this is v6.0.3 ;)
I will proceed to close the ticket since it has been resolved.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0445275-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/R7 170002201] Display shows blue screen CRM:02889000473
additional_info.body:
Hi again,
Problem solved:
I believe there was an incompatibility with the name of the photo since I changed the name to "photo.png" and it works.
When you have this problem be sure to test with the simplest name of all.
I will close the ticket.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
